the_ruling_in_three_parts.ownership: OPEN QUESTIONS LAND WITH CC. Law 6, and it is a correction: the questions store's charter gives each PROBE an owner, and says nothing about who owns the open lane. It is CC's — raising, holding, and checking them is CC's job, not a queue handed to Akien. What reaches Akien is the SURFACE (part three), not the custody.
the_ruling_in_three_parts.intake: EVERY 'it's worth making clear i didn't do x, y or z' BECOMES AN OPEN QUESTION. Not most. Not the important ones. The word is ALWAYS. A caveat is CC's own measurement that a frontier exists, made at the one moment the frontier is fully in view — and today it is spent as prose in a turn nobody re-reads. This is the same shape as the store charter's own founding fear: an intake with no drain is 'the APPEARANCE of capture'. Here it is worse — a measurement with no intake at all.
the_ruling_in_three_parts.the_read_trigger: 'WHAT'S NEXT' CHECKS OPEN QUESTIONS FIRST. Before tickets, before the slate's next_direction, before anything CC would otherwise reach for. The ordering is the ruling: a next-step chosen without reading the open frontier is a next-step chosen against a map with its edges cropped off.
the_ruling_in_three_parts.the_surface: THE OPEN LANE RIDES THE SESSION-OPEN HOOK, in the same place that today says findings await his verdict — 'you still have things to decide on'. Akien sees the lane; he does not own it.

what_already_exists_measured_2026_08_11.the_store: CairnCommons/questions/ with `the_open_lane` chartered (ruling 2026-08-01-edges-become-open-questions, confirmed): homeless open questions are `open-*.json` carrying {id, date, raised_by, question, whats_beyond, source, resolved}. FOUR live members today: open-alarms-pane-or-channel, open-a-scanning-tooth-passes-because-of-the-defect, open-the-frontier-projector, open-who-is-a-troubles-recipient.
what_already_exists_measured_2026_08_11.the_lane_is_compiled_never_copied: By that same charter the lane has TWO sources: (1) every charter's `filed_edges`, which live beside the code they bound (Law 5) and appear only through a projector's render, and (2) the homeless `open-*.json` files. This is why the lane 'cannot become the accumulator the no_drain_yet clause fears: it has no independent existence to rot.'
what_already_exists_measured_2026_08_11.the_display_seam: bin/cmd/slate --hook already runs at every session open and already carries the exact surface named: the trouble lane at the top, then 'AT AKIEN'S GATE — N finding(s) awaiting his verdict'. Adding a lane is adding a lane, not building a surface.
what_already_exists_measured_2026_08_11.the_intake_seam: bin/cmd/turnscan already runs at the Stop hook and already reads CC's turn text for a lexical shape (concern marker + forward proposal, no disposition between). It is the right seam and the wrong instrument — its own docstring says so: 'It cannot tell a concern about work in flight from the word "caveat" in a retrospective, and it never will... The host also offers prompt-type hooks (an LLM adjudicates the condition), which is where this goes when the floor's residue is measured and found to matter.' This ruling is the measurement that the residue matters.

what_is_missing: THE LANE IN THE HOOK. slate has no questions lane. The homeless half is readable today with a glob over open-*.json filtered on `resolved`; nothing in the program does it. This is the small half and it is the half he asked for by name.

THE PROJECTOR. The `filed_edges` half of the compiled lane has no renderer — and that absence is already a member of the lane it is missing from (open-the-frontier-projector.json). So a lane shipped today shows the homeless half and must SAY it is showing half, or it becomes the cropped map this ruling is against.

THE INTAKE. Nothing turns a caveat into an open-*.json. Not turnscan, not the door, not a hook. Until physics covers it this is an IOU discharged by CC's hand at the moment of writing the caveat — file it in the same act, never 'later'. Law 4: prose here is an IOU, and this one is named as one rather than resting.

THE READ TRIGGER. Nothing makes 'what's next' consult the lane. Once the lane prints at session open the context carries it, which is a weaker mechanism than a check and is the resting state until the lane exists to check.
what_this_settles_elsewhere: THE /design QUESTION, in the same breath. CC had argued that design's one irreplaceable field was `open_questions` — the only thing in its packet that /sorted's four completeness ANSWERS do not hold — and that it had nowhere else to land. It lands here. That was the last argument for keeping /design as a door, and this ruling removes it. See the design thread: 27 sorted firings carry no upstream citation of any kind, and the design content has been migrating into sorted's own checks on its own (1,375 chars on 2026-08-03 to 9,019 on 2026-08-11).
